name: Negaeui Bit
source:
I am lost in time and turned my back on the world with the angel.

"The more you care about someone, the more unfortunate they will be."

The last generation that the prophecy of god comes true.
Lucifer and the Dreamp corps that have conquered the entire world are trying to fall the children of gods into despair, hiding the truth of the world.

This is the endgame.
Turn your back on the world with the angel, and protect your loved ones.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2444660/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
我迷失在时间里，背弃了与天使一起的世界。

“你越在乎一个人，他就越不幸。”

最后一代神的预言成真了。
路西法和征服了整个世界的梦军团试图让众神之子陷入绝望，隐藏世界的真相。

这是终局。
与天使一起背弃这个世界，保护你所爱的人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2444660/]Steam[/url]]
